title: Compiled combo program (plan §8.2; atlas docs/atlas/combo-program.md)
description: Hand-authored per-combo execution plan, polymorphic on program_class. v1 enforces the ENVELOPE (schema tag, the program_class whitelist, the id/name/provenance, piece shape) and CLOSES the top-level key set so a typo'd body key fails at author-time instead of the runtime program_class_unsupported / empty-block abort. The class-specific body blocks (loop/sink/window/engine/...) are validated for presence only in v1; per-class deep validation is a v2 refinement keyed on program_class. Reverse-engineered from 52 working files across 5 decks — widen to reality, never break a working program (plan §6).

program_class.description: Selects the runner in ComboAwareLobbyPlayer. OPTIONAL: an absent value defaults to ping_loop (ProgramRunner). When present it MUST be one of the authored classes below — 'unreadable' is a runtime parse-failure sentinel and is never authored. An out-of-set value is exactly the program_class_unsupported abort this enum prevents.

combo_id.description: MUST equal the filename id (combo-program-<id>.json) AND a registered combo id in combos.json / discovered-combos.json (the three-way match). Cross-file check is a validator-v2 / register-time job, not expressible in this schema.

compiled_from.description: Free-form provenance — the author's cross-check (script_cross_check / script_hashes / oracle_cross_check / *_rationale / regression_note / feasibility ...). Kept open on purpose: the discipline is that it quotes real script costs, not that it has fixed keys.

pieces.description: The combo's pieces. OPTIONAL (2 working files declare pieces implicitly via compiled_from). Each entry is EITHER a named piece (card) OR a template piece (template, resolved at runtime from resolve_from) — the runtime analogue of Spellbook template_requirements. Requiring one identity or the other still catches a piece with no identity at all.

resolve_from.description: Candidate cards the runner fills the template slot from.

requires.description: Zone the piece must be in (HAND / BATTLEFIELD, plus attachment prose). Read by the piece-attachment gate.

runner.description: Prose naming the runner + line (documentation, not parsed).

loop.description: Body: tap/untap or recursion loop (mana_loop / selvala_mana_loop / bounce_recur / cast_recur / cast_bounce).
